name: 2026 Topps SP / SSP / Variations
notes: Every base-style short print, super short print and image variation from 2026 Topps Series 1, Series 2 and Update, all teams, in card-number order (filter by series and variation type). Parallels (Gold, Rainbow Foil, numbered colors…) are not here — they stay on the base checklists and in the My Parallels folders. SP/SSP: Topps only prints “SP” on a few cards (Series 2 Short Print Rookies, Update Traded Players). Team Color Border (~1:230 hobby) is called SP and the rarer types (Golden Mirror, Clear, True Photo, Vintage Stock, Player Number, Rookie 1952…) SSP by hobby convention from Topps pack odds — those labels are unconfirmed. Holiday, Companion and Big Apple Foil are retail/box exclusives, not short prints. Funko, Through the Years and SportsCardsPro-only image variations are marked Unconfirmed. Checklists: Diamond Cards Online (Series 1/2), My Card Batch, Dugout Vault (Update), Topps/Beckett pack odds, SportsCardsPro (prices, photos, Golden Mirror lists).
